profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer II at Guild Education
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer that thrives on problem solving and discovery. To me, code is a giant puzzle that I can’t wait to solve. 

I've always had an interest in what makes websites work, and how making small tweaks with coding can become an extension of design. This led me into my career as a Digital Marketer where I was able to explore email development, website strategy and user experience. 

The more I learned about web applications and strategy, the more I wanted to dive into the components involved in building that application. Now I’m a TDD enthusiast that loves bringing User Stories to life, debugging complex issues, and bringing all the right pieces of the puzzle together to create something new. 

GitHub: https://github.com/jalena-penaligon

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Ruby on Rails · Front-End Development

positions.title: Email and Web Associate Manager
positions.description:
- Responsible for managing the business' website, mobile app and email marketing channel.
- Worked as the liaison between the development team and customer support team through ongoing projects, a website redesign and a mobile app launch.
- Built landing pages for seasonal promotions and events.
- Developed all email templates and content, segmented audience targeting lists, and reported on metrics. Increased the business's mailing list by 107%

positions.title: Product Marketing Specialist
positions.description:
- Manage direct email marketing from scheduling to execution. Optimize email templates for consistency and deliverability across all email domains. 
- Implement social media strategies to enhance reach and engagement across multiple platforms. 
- Design promotional web pages, banners and marketing collateral for all sales events. Formulate strategies to boost traffic and revenue.
- Update website and blog content for search engine optimization. 
- Track daily, weekly and monthly revenue trends and gap analysis reports to improve brand specific promotions and target marketing efforts.

positions.title: Small Business Funding Advisor
positions.description:
- Close new business consistently and follow up on leads to maintain an active pipeline daily
- Understand and apply concepts of deal structure and strategy that are proven models for successful achievement
- Generate new business with a high volume of phone conversations daily
- Analyze customer bank statements and merchant processing statements
- Educate the customer about the financial product that would best improve their business

positions.title: Senior Sales Representative
positions.description:
- Responsible for selling, renewing, and expanding the service relationships clients have with their existing customer base. 
- Utilizes databases to research accounts, generate quotes, and uncover new opportunities and work effectively with strategic, high dollar accounts.

positions.title: Creative Department Intern
positions.description: Projects include assisting the development of new client presentation books, and designing website graphics and fliers for various clients.
